analysis: Both units are head-side text from CHANGELOG.md, with no executable source, config or schema changes. The supplied text is documentation only; the diff is not shown, so I could not tell which lines were added. The top entry says coordinator logs will no longer contain emails, client IPs, device serials or MDA UDIDs. That reduces exposure for T-051 and T-058 (identity leakage via logs and Datadog) and does not weaken any mitigation. The changelog does describe security-relevant behavior that other reviewers should verify against the actual source, because this pass did not see the code. These are: the removal of the unauthenticated /v1/provider/earnings endpoint (T-031) and of the telemetry route; attestation challenges failing closed on a missing status_signature or secure_boot_enabled (T-036, T-037); App Attest protocol 3 only (TB-011, T-052..T-058); the SSD prefix-cache TTL raised from 15 to 30 minutes, which is documented as a SEC-035 re-acceptance and is consistent with the T-041 text; demand-gated SSD writes; the SSD write budget raised to 750 GB/day; Autopilot live-lease gating; and the public model-demand publication thresholds (k>=20 requests, 3 accounts). Claims of this kind cannot be confirmed from changelog text. The threat model already covers the 30-minute TTL. There is a possible gap: the 750 GB/day SSD write budget and the 'default-on, demand-gated' write policy are not reflected in T-041's disk-wear text. This is minor and does not qualify as a finding. No findings are raised.
